name: Authorization UM2.1 -Multiple Authorizations 100% Match Navigator
description: Walk the Authorization (UM) SOP for the PX_UM2 event -multiple authorizations are on file in CI&W that are a 100% match. Identify the PX_UM2 event, confirm the UM Rule ID is not one of the four flagged IDs, confirm the provider is not a Hospital Based Physician, run the eight Claim-Lines exclusion checks, confirm the claim type, confirm the authorization match shows MULTIMATCH, note the member identity and service-line values, cross-check the claim against each authorization row to identify the correct one (dates in range, Status Approved), tag the correct authorization onto the claim line, then pay the claim.

steps.name: Review all events and identify the PX_UM2 event
steps.description: Review all events in the Event Resolution tab, including informational events, before paying, denying, or routing the claim when multiple events are set. The PX_UM2 event will be displayed in the events list -this Authorization event occurs when there are multiple authorizations on file in CI&W that are a 100% match with the claim.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Event Resolution tab and reviews the events list, where the PX_UM2 event is shown.
steps.hint: Open 'Event Resolution' and review the events list. The active PX_UM2 event is shown -multiple authorizations are on file that are a 100% match.
steps.checklistItem: Review all events and identify the PX_UM2 event

steps.name: Check the UM Rule ID
steps.description: Determine whether the UM Rule ID is one of the following: MMS001, PSYCH001, ASCRULE01, or NYSTATE02. Navigate to the Claim Data tab, then the Review sub-tab, and expand the Utilization Management section. Review the UM Detail Service table, which contains the Line #, Procedure, Revenue Code, Date, Rule ID, and Case Number columns, and identify the value displayed in the Rule ID column. If the Rule ID matches any of the specified values (MMS001, PSYCH001, ASCRULE01, or NYSTATE02), follow the alternate SOP steps. If none of these Rule IDs is present, proceed to the next step. In this scenario, the Rule ID is INPAT001, which does not match any of the specified values; therefore, the trainee may proceed to the next step.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Review sub-tab inside Claim Data and reads the UM Detail Service table's Rule ID.
steps.hint: Open 'Claim Data' → 'Review' and expand Utilization management. The UM Detail Service Rule ID is INPAT001 -not one of MMS001 / PSYCH001 / ASCRULE01 / NYSTATE02 -so proceed.

steps.name: Check for a Hospital Based Physician
steps.description: Verify whether the provider billed on the claim qualifies as a Hospital Based Physician by navigating to the Provider Information tab, then the Rendering section, and reviewing the Specialty Description field. A provider is considered a Hospital Based Physician if the Specialty Description is Anesthesiology, Radiology, Emergency Room Physician, Pathology, Assistant Surgeon, Neonatology, Intensivist, or Hospitalist. If the provider is identified as a Hospital Based Physician, follow the alternate SOP steps. If the provider does not fall within one of these specialties, proceed to the next step. In this scenario, the Specialty Description is Cardiology; therefore, the provider is not considered a Hospital Based Physician, and the trainee may proceed to the next step.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Provider Information tab to read the Rendering Speciality Description.
steps.hint: Open 'Provider Info' and read the Speciality description under Rendering -it is Cardiology, not a Hospital Based Physician specialty, so proceed.
steps.checklistItem: Check for a Hospital Based Physician

steps.name: Run the Claim Lines exclusion checks
steps.description:
On the Claim Lines tab, check eight exclusion conditions against the claim line. For this claim, the line shows Procedure 92928, Modifier "—", and POS 21.

For each check, if the condition matches, follow the alternate SOP steps. Otherwise, proceed to the next check.
Consulting Physician -Procedure code is 99231–99233 or 99251–99255. (92928 → no match)

Modifier 26 -Modifiers field equals 26. ("—" → no match)

Implants -Procedure code starts with C or L. (92928 → no match)

PAP / CPAP / BIPAP machines or supplies -Procedure code starts with E. (92928 → no match)

Chiropractic with PT, or PT alone -Procedure code is A2000–A2999. (92928 → no match)

Emergency Room or Urgent Care -POS is 23 (ER) or 20 (Urgent Care). (21 → no match)

Ambulance services -POS is 41 or 42. (21 → no match)

Drug administration -Procedure code is J0000–J8999. (92928 → no match)
In this scenario, none of the eight conditions match, so the trainee proceeds.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Claim Lines tab to run the eight exclusion checks against the Procedure, Modifiers, and POS fields.
steps.hint: Open 'Claim Lines'. Procedure 92928 (not 99231–99255 / C / L / E / A2xxx / J-code), Modifier '-' (not 26), and POS 21 (not 23/20/41/42) -none of the eight exclusions match, so proceed.
steps.checklistItem: Run the Claim Lines exclusion checks

steps.name: Check the claim type against the SOP table
steps.description: Determine whether the claim falls under a scenario defined in the UM Events Authorization SOP by navigating to the Claim Data tab, then the Details sub-tab, and reviewing the Claim Type field. Compare the Claim Type value against the scenarios listed in the UM Events Authorization SOP table. If the value matches a scenario in the table, follow the corresponding SOP instructions for that scenario. If the value does not match any listed scenario, proceed to the next step. In this scenario, the Claim Type is Professional, which does not correspond to a scenario requiring special handling; therefore, the trainee may proceed to the next step.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Details sub-tab inside Claim Data to read the claim type.
steps.hint: Open 'Claim Data' → 'Details' and read the claim type -it is Professional, which is not one of the SOP-table scenarios, so proceed.
steps.checklistItem: Check the claim type against the SOP table

steps.name: Verify the authorization match
steps.description: Verify whether a matching authorization exists for the claim line(s) requiring authorization by navigating to the Claim Data tab, then the Review sub-tab, and expanding the Utilization Management section. Review the UM Detail Service table and examine the Case Number column for the applicable claim line(s). A valid Case Number indicates that a matching authorization exists. A value of NO MATCH indicates that an authorization exists but does not correspond to the billed service. A blank Case Number field indicates that no authorization exists. A value of MULTIMATCH indicates that multiple matching authorizations have been identified for the claim line. In this scenario, the Case Number field displays MULTIMATCH, indicating that multiple matching authorizations exist for the claim line. Therefore, the trainee must identify and validate the correct authorization before proceeding.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Review sub-tab inside Claim Data and reads the UM Detail Service table's Case Number.
steps.hint: Open 'Claim Data' → 'Review' and read the Case Number in the UM Detail Service table -it shows MULTIMATCH (multiple authorizations exist), so identify the correct authorization.

steps.name: Note the member identity values
steps.description: To determine the correct authorization, the trainee compares patient name, member code, place of service, dates of service, procedure codes, and units between the claim and each authorization on file. Open the Member Information tab and note the First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, and Member code.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Member Information tab to note the member identity values.
steps.hint: Open 'Member Info' and note First/Middle/Last name (John / Doe / Andrew) and Member code 20.

steps.name: Note the service line values
steps.description: Open the Claim Lines tab and note the Units, POS, Procedure, From date, and To date for each billed service line.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Claim Lines tab again to note the Units, POS, and service dates for both billed lines.
steps.hint: Open 'Claim Lines' and note Units 4, POS 21, From 05/28/2026, To 05/30/2026 for both billed service lines.

steps.name: Cross-check claim details and identify the correct authorization
steps.description: Cross-check the values documented from the Member Information tab and the Claim Lines tab against the values displayed in the Claim Data tab, then the Review sub-tab, and the Authorization section. Expand the Authorization section to review the available fields: Authorization #, Date Range, Procedure, Provider, Status, Svc Type, and Score. Verify that the From Date and To Date from the Claim Lines tab fall within the Date Range of the authorization. Select the chevron (>) icon, or click the authorization row, to expand the authorization details and review the Member Name, Member Code, Procedure, Requested Units, Approved Units, and POS fields. Compare these values to the corresponding claim details to confirm that the authorization applies to the services billed. Finally, review the Status field to determine the authorization decision. If the Status is Approved, indicating that authorization has been approved for all billed services and dates of service, proceed to the next step. If the Status is anything other than Approved, follow the alternate SOP steps. In this scenario, the Status is Approved; therefore, the trainee may proceed to the next step.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee expands an authorization row (which dispatches the expand_authorization action) to compare the two authorizations against the claim.
steps.hint: On 'Claim Data' → 'Review', expand both authorization rows. UM98464938 (02/20/2026–03/22/2026, Denied) is out of range; UM98464939 (04/28/2026–06/28/2026, Approved) covers the claim's 05/28/2026–05/30/2026 dates -that is the correct authorization.
steps.checklistItem: Cross-check claim details and identify the correct authorization

steps.name: Tag the correct authorization to the claim line
steps.description: Tag the correct authorization in the Case Number field of the UM Detail Service sub-section under the Utilization management section. A radio button (circle button) appears at the start of each authorization row; click the radio button on the second authorization row (UM98464939), and a Tag button will appear. Click the Tag button to move the Authorization # of that row into the Case Number field of the Utilization management section, replacing the existing MULTIMATCH value. With the correct authorization tagged, the trainee can now proceed to pay the claim.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee selects the correct authorization row's radio and clicks Tag (which dispatches the tag_authorization action), moving UM98464939 into the Case Number cell.
steps.hint: Click the radio on the second authorization row (UM98464939), then click the Tag button. The Case Number cell changes from MULTIMATCH to UM98464939.
steps.checklistItem: Tag the correct authorization to the claim line

steps.name: Submit Pay decision
steps.description: Navigate to the Decision section in the header, select 'Pay' from the dropdown menu and click Submit.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee confirms the Pay decision in the submit dialog.
steps.hint: Pick 'Pay' from the Decision dropdown in the claim header, then click Submit and confirm in the dialog.
